title: feat: expressive mode
description:
LLM-driven TTS prosody via provider-specific markup tags, end to end:

- Provider-keyed markup pipeline in tts/_provider_format.py (LLM tag instructions, transcript stripping, normalize + convert to native syntax); base TTS.Markup delegates on _provider_key() so plugins override one method.
- In-house per-provider input chunking: when expressiveness is on, sentences batch up to the provider send limit (Inworld 900, Cartesia 400) for continuous prosody; per-sentence otherwise. Defaults live in _provider_format.
- ExpressiveContent captured on assistant messages and re-injected on later turns so the model sees its own expressive style.
- Conversational / customer-service / healthcare presets, wired into the drive-thru, frontdesk, healthcare and survey examples.
- Inference gateway + cartesia/elevenlabs/inworld plugin markup; assorted STT/telemetry/audio-recognition updates carried on the branch.

bugs.summary: safe_render promises that a placeholder with no value logs and renders empty, but its get_field fallback only catches KeyError/AttributeError/TypeError and substitutes an empty string: a positional placeholder ({} or {0}) raises IndexError from the empty args tuple, and a missing field with a format spec ({price:.2f}) hands "" to format_field, which raises ValueError, so rendering the instructions crashes instead of leaving the gap empty.
bugs.trigger: Render Instructions("Hello {name}, total {}") or Instructions("Hello {name}, price {price:.2f}") with data={"name": "Alex"} (no value for the other placeholder).
